args.body: Hi Dora, I visited your website. It clearly presents itself as your personal site, and the simple identity is a good starting point. To make it more engaging, consider adding a short introduction, highlighting your work or interests, and including clear navigation and contact/social links. A few project images or featured sections could also help visitors quickly understand what you do.

To strengthen the site, consider featuring recent or highlighted posts on the homepage, adding categories or tags, and including a brief author bio. Hiking photos, readable post previews, and clear subscription or contact options could make the blog more inviting and easier to explore.
